cd /workspace/mytests && python3 - <<'EOF'
from harness import *
H=[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"]]}]
# chunked with a huge chunk
expr = '{{ b"POST /c HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: h.example\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\\r\\n\\r\\n" + b"1000000000\\r\\n" + b"y"*68719476736 + b"\\r\\n0\\r\\nT: 1\\r\\n\\r\\n" }}'
d = base(cases=[case('a',H, method='POST', target='/c')],
         events=[{"at":1,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True}],
         channels=[{"name":"ch","parts":[{"case":"a","data":expr}]}])
o,rc,err = run(d, debug=True)
r = o['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
print('chunked huge:', r['framing'], r['body'], r['trailers'], r['flags'], o['channels'][0]['error'], o['cases'][0]['flags'])
print('stderr', err[-500:])

# owners: multi-part with mixed labels
parts = [{"case":"a","data":"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\n"},
         {"case":None,"data":""},
         {"case":"b","data":"Content-Length: 0\r\n\r\n"}]
d = base(cases=[case('a',H), case('b',H)], channels=[{"name":"ch","parts":parts}])
o = run(d)[0]
print('mixed owners:', o['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['owner'], o['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['owners'], o['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'])
print('case flags:', [(c['name'],c['flags'],c['origin_count']) for c in o['cases']])
print('committed:', o['channels'][0]['committed'])

# unattributed owner null
d = base(cases=[case('a',H)], channels=[{"name":"ch","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n"}]}])
o = run(d)[0]
print('null owner:', o['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['owner'], o['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['owners'], o['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'], [(c['origin_count'],c['flags']) for c in o['cases']])

# extra: same owner twice
data = "GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n"
d = base(cases=[case('a',H)], channels=[{"name":"c1","parts":[{"case":"a","data":data}]},
                                        {"name":"c2","parts":[{"case":"a","data":data}]}])
o = run(d)[0]
print('extra:', [ (ch['name'], [r['flags'] for r in ch['requests']]) for ch in o['channels']], o['cases'][0]['origin_count'], o['cases'][0]['flags'])

# multiple host
d = base(cases=[case('a',H)], channels=[{"name":"c1","parts":[{"case":"a","data":"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: a\r\nhost: b\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n"}]}])
o=run(d)[0]; print('multihost:', o['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['host_count'], o['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['host'], o['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'])

# unsent: owner sent only a datagram
d = base(cases=[case('a',[{"Type":"datagram","data_to_transfered":"x"}])],
         channels=[{"name":"c1","parts":[{"case":"a","data":data}]}])
o=run(d)[0]; print('unsent:', o['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'], o['cases'][0]['flags'], o['cases'][0]['request_frames'], o['cases'][0]['frames'])
EOF
